decision: Keep both sheets as visible review drafts; no artistic or gameplay validation.

fidelityBasis.basis: Reviewed against the local selected-variant invariants and the two actual saved sheets. Official reference pages were not reopened in this registration subtask; prior reference inspection is recorded in fidelity.json.

inspection.browser: Headless installed Chrome through existing Playwright; the existing V28 review client drew original PNG cells with registered support pivots.
inspection.limitations: Still images and automated non-loop playback were checked. No claim of a human-observed continuous video, motion capture, independent animator approval or simulation integration.

observed: An adult human face, short black hair and closed human boots remain visible in all twelve cells; no Yautja mandibles or clawed bare feet.
Two arms and two legs remain readable; the weapon hand is connected to its wrist and forearm in the inspected close-ups. No obvious extra or detached limb was found.
The other hand remains separate: held in a fist in guard/recoil poses, then brought to the abdomen in hit-reaction pose4.
The machete remains attached to the same anatomical right hand; its handle and pommel are distinguishable in the close-ups.
Gold armor, dark ribbed under-suit, central hanging plates, shoulder armor and forearm armor remain in the same broad configuration. No shoulder cannon is present.
notCertified: Closed gloves and overlap hide individual digits; a five-finger anatomy certificate cannot be inferred from these views.
Facial likeness to every original comic panel was not established; identity is checked against the selected local contract only.
Decorative plate lines, face outlines and weapon surface marks drift between drawings; they are not a rigid-model consistency proof.
The green marks are baked into the source drawing, not separately controllable blood or combat effects.

observations.assessment: Broad curved machete low at the right side; separate left fist and stable wrist attachment.
Both blades now point upward and handles/pommels remain attached to the gripping hand. The previously reported downward pose3 defect is not present in this selected PNG.
Near-equivalent high-guard silhouettes: support-aligned IoU0.926963. Treat them as entry/hold candidates, not two proven distinct transition stages.
Backward torso lean and bent knees make the recoil readable. Both visible boot support bands remain preserved; the farther boot retains its authored perspective height.
Near-equivalent low-ready return silhouettes: IoU0.953894. They are hold/settling candidates; a meaningful lowering transition is not established.
Start/end ready silhouettes overlap0.960747 after support alignment, with small drawing differences. This is not a seamless-loop certificate; the clip remains non-looping.

Review weapon length/curvature, gold plate contours and glove grip in a continuous slow-motion loop and across adjoining actions.
Author explicit entry/hold/exit timing and the opposite orientation as separately drawn assets before any guarded-combat claim.

observations.assessment: Readable human ready stance, closed gloves and boots; right-hand blade stays low.
Two visibly different backward recoils; support-aligned silhouette IoU0.678595 supports a larger pose change than the guard holds.
Forward fold, bent knees and left hand at the abdomen are readable. Enlarged source inspection keeps the right-hand machete and left-hand abdomen contact distinct; no extra hand is obvious.
The figure returns upright while keeping the same blade hand and broad armor configuration. Its reduced height during the fold is preserved, not normalized away.
Ready-return silhouettes overlap0.900813 after support alignment; stance/contour shifts remain and are not resolved by pivot registration.

blockingIssuesBeforeProduction: Review the abrupt transition from peak backward recoil to the deep forward fold with an animator; an added bridge pose may be needed.
Confirm how grounded torso recoil maps to a specific game hit reaction; these proposed durations do not define stun frames.
Draw and validate the opposite orientation and transitions from/to actual idle/guard clips before integration.

remainingWork: No opposite-facing drawn sheets were provided; no automatic mirror has been applied.
Idle locomotion, attacks, crouching, jumping, throws, knockdowns and the rest of the full character contract remain separate missing work.
Source-only registration does not grant validated atlas status. Keep all twelve cells draft until visual continuity and the needed clip contracts are approved.
